cues.text: Mitsuru leads you, Yukari, Fuuka, Junpei and Akihiko into the large entrance hall of her family's vacation home. You all stop in a line behind her. Yukari, Fuuka and Junpei stare around, wide-eyed.
A door opens and two maids walk up and stand before Mitsuru.
Another door opens. The maids step aside, and a tall man in a suit, a patch over one eye, walks up to Mitsuru.
The man walks off past the maids, along your line and out of sight. You all turn to watch him go.
